title: 9-Day Morocco Tour: Imperial Cities & Sahara
metaDescription: Explore Fez, Rabat and Marrakech before crossing Morocco's desert landscapes on a 9-day journey combining imperial cities, kasbahs and the Sahara.
breadcrumb: Explore Our Travel Destinations & Multi-Country Tours
summary:
The 8-Day Morocco Vacation Package moves through several distinct sides of the country, from the Atlantic coast and Rif Mountains to the historic medinas of Fez and Marrakech. Start in Casablanca and Rabat before continuing to Fez, where narrow medina streets, traditional workshops and historic quarters shape the experience. Chefchaouen changes the setting with its hillside location in northern Morocco, while Marrakech brings the journey south to its souks, old city and public squares.
The route is arranged privately and operates year-round. Accommodation combines selected hotels and traditional riads, with breakfast, English-speaking local guides, transfers, entrance fees and scheduled sightseeing provided along the way.

itinerary.title: Sunday: Arrival to Fez
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Fès–Saïss Airport and meet with our representative. Transfer to your hotel in Fez.
Hotel check-in after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Fez.

itinerary.title: Monday: Visiting Fez
itinerary.text: Full-day tour of Fez, Morocco’s spiritual and cultural capital. Explore the Medieval Medina, traditional souks, the Royal Palace of Fez, Bou Inania Madrasa, and Nejjarine Fountain. See the exterior of the Moulay Idriss II Mausoleum and University of al-Qarawiyyin Mosque. Overnight in Fez.

itinerary.title: Tuesday: Fez- Rabat - Marrakech (495 km)
itinerary.text: Drive to Rabat, the administrative capital of Morocco. Visit the Royal Palace of Rabat (Mechouar), Mausoleum of Mohammed V, and Hassan Tower. Optional seafood lunch in Rabat. Continue to Marrakesh via highway. Overnight in Marrakesh.

itinerary.title: Wednesday: Marrakech
itinerary.text: Full-day tour of Marrakech, known as the “Ochre City.” Visit the Menara Gardens, Bahia Palace, Koutoubia Mosque, and Dar Si Said Museum. Lunch at the hotel. Explore the traditional souks and handicraft quarters before visiting the famous Jemaa el-Fnaa square with its lively entertainment. Optional dinner with traditional show. Overnight in Marrakech

itinerary.title: Thursday: Marrakech – Ait Benhaddou – Zagora (380 km)
itinerary.text: Drive through the Tizi n'Tichka mountain pass at 2,260 meters altitude. Visit Aït Benhaddou, the famous UNESCO-listed Kasbah featured in many movies and TV series. Optional lunch during the tour. Continue through the scenic Draa Valley to Zagora. Overnight in Zagora.

itinerary.title: Friday: Zagora - Nkob - Tazzarine - Erfoud (300km)
itinerary.text: Drive to Erfoud through Morocco’s pre-Saharan landscapes. Stop at Tamegroute, famous for its traditional pottery workshops. Pass through the villages of Tansikht, Nkob, Tazzarine, and Alnif, with optional lunch in Alnif. Continue via Rissani, birthplace of the Alaouite Dynasty. Optional 4x4 excursion to the Erg Chebbi dunes in Merzouga. Overnight in Erfoud.

itinerary.title: Saturday Erfoud - Tinghir- Ouarzazate (350 km)
itinerary.text: Optional early morning 4x4 excursion to Erg Chebbi to watch the sunrise. Drive to Tinghir and visit the spectacular Todra Gorge. Optional lunch at a local restaurant near the canyons. Continue via the famous Road of 1,000 Kasbahs through Kelaat Mgouna and the Skoura Oasis valley. Arrive in Ouarzazate and enjoy a short city tour. Overnight in Ouarzazate.

itinerary.title: Sunday: Ouarzazate - Marrakech (220 km)
itinerary.text: Drive to Marrakech. Optional lunch at a local restaurant. Free afternoon for leisure or optional activities and excursions. Overnight in Marrakech

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 9 Days Morocco Vacation Package?
faqs.a: The 9 Days Morocco Vacation Package covers Fez, Rabat, Erfoud, Marrakech, and Ouarzazate. This comprehensive journey showcases Morocco's imperial cities, ancient medinas, desert landscapes, historic kasbahs, and vibrant cultural traditions. The tour runs for 8 nights and 9 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 9 Days Morocco Vacation Package cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €1,495 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, private land transportation, guided sightseeing tours, selected meals, and transfers according to the itinerary. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel category.

faqs.q: Is transportation included throughout the tour?
faqs.a: Yes, private land transportation is included throughout the itinerary. Travelers enjoy comfortable travel between destinations while experiencing Morocco's diverse scenery, including mountains, valleys, desert landscapes, and historic cities.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes accommodation in carefully selected hotels and traditional Moroccan riads with daily breakfast. Properties are chosen for their comfort, quality service, and authentic Moroccan character.

faqs.q: Does the tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides accompany the scheduled sightseeing tours. Your guide will provide valuable insights into Morocco's history, architecture, culture, and local traditions throughout the journey.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Morocco?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors. It covers many of Morocco's most iconic destinations, providing an excellent introduction to the country's history, culture, landscapes, and hospitality.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is easy to moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through medinas, historic sites, markets, and desert areas. Most visitors with average fitness levels can comfortably participate throughout the trip.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Fez, Rabat, Erfoud, Marrakech, and Ouarzazate?
faqs.a: Fez is famous for its UNESCO-listed medieval medina and traditional artisan workshops. Rabat features elegant historic monuments and coastal attractions. Erfoud serves as a gateway to the Sahara Desert and is known for its dramatic desert scenery. Marrakech captivates visitors with its colorful souks, palaces, and lively atmosphere. Ouarzazate is renowned for its kasbahs, cinematic landscapes, and role as Morocco's film-making center.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 9 Days Morocco Vacation Package?
faqs.a: You can generally cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within the applicable cancellation period may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Can the 9 Days Morocco Vacation Package be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade accommodations, include a luxury Sahara Desert camp, visit Chefchaouen or Casablanca, or modify the itinerary to suit your travel interests. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
